

== Original and later persona-title states ==
The printed title changed from “Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous” to “Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl”. The game text shown on the two inspected slips is unchanged. Both source images have been checked. The original has its own full card article at [[Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous (V)]]. Compilation dates do not establish the precise effective date of each state. The dated source-history audit remains open.
